text: Hello! This is a speech synthesis test.
Today we are comparing several text to speech models.
Neural networks can generate natural sounding speech.
Autoregressive models may produce better prosody.
Parallel models generate audio much faster.
This experiment runs on Google Colab with TTS models.
The VITS model is a modern end to end architecture.
XTTS is capable of cross lingual voice cloning.
Some models require more VRAM during inference.
We will analyze quality, speed, and resource usage.
